device.name: Isaac Lab-Arena (Isaac Lab manager-based Gymnasium environment)

facts.text: IsaacLabArenaManagerBasedRLEnv extends Isaac Lab's vectorized ManagerBasedRLEnv
The environment is constructed from a composed IsaacLabArenaManagerBasedRLEnvCfg and an optional render_mode
reset(seed, env_ids, options) forwards to ManagerBasedRLEnv.reset; with an episode limit only the initial explicit reset is allowed
step takes a torch action tensor and returns the vectorized step tuple, reporting completions only for environments that were assigned an episode before the step
The Arena environment cfg sets sim.dt to 1/120 s and decimation to 8, a 15 Hz control rate by default

An embodiment offers one or more control variants, for example franka_ik uses differential IK control while franka_joint_pos uses direct joint position control, so the composed embodiment selects the action terms
A policy receives the observation as a Gymnasium spaces Dict and returns an action tensor shaped like env.action_space
Setting --seed fixes the simulation and the run-time variation draws
build_registered takes the Gymnasium id from self.arena_env.name
ArenaEnvBuilder registers the composed environment with gym.register(id=name, entry_point=...); the id is therefore chosen by the composed IsaacLabArenaEnvironment
Documentation states that the compiled config is registered with the gym registry under the environment's name and gym.make() returns the environment
The default Gymnasium entry point is IsaacLabArenaManagerBasedRLEnv; mimic mode uses the embodiment's mimic environment instead
The README example composes an environment with ArenaEnvBuilder.make_registered and calls env.reset()
The prerequisites are Linux (Ubuntu 22.04+) and an NVIDIA GPU

determinism.notes: the fake seeds Python's random.Random from reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 and its one kinematic update is deterministic; the upstream seed controls Isaac Lab's generators and the Arena variation draws, and the two were not compared because the upstream stack was not run

gaps: kinematic F0 stand-in: no Isaac Sim physics, contacts, actuator, sensor, noise or rendering model; the fake advances one scalar coordinate per tick and claims no dynamics

the real action space is the batched Box of Isaac Lab's action manager whose width is the sum of the action term dimensions, and the real observation is a Dict of group Boxes, both chosen by the composed environment; the fake uses a one-element action Box and one policy group, so the arrays are smaller than the device's
the upstream environment is vectorized over num_envs while the MHS Gymnasium bridge drives one environment; the upstream path was not executed (it needs Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Linux and an NVIDIA GPU)

there is no fixed env_id to gym.make: ArenaEnvBuilder registers the composed environment under its user-chosen name, so only the package fake backend is provided and the upstream simulator path is not configured
timestep_ms is 0 because the fake is event-driven per tick; the upstream Arena cfg uses a 15 Hz control step by default (sim.dt 1/120 s x decimation 8) and an env_cfg_callback can change it
snapshot and restore are not offered: the fake exposes no get_state/set_state
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and clock lockstep

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
